title: Add local update and rollback drill view
verified: update.rollback.show renders release update metadata, detached signature state, A/B rootfs strategy and rollback drill evidence as a read-only TUI projection.
The panel exposes active, pending and rollback slot evidence using release artifacts and update_readiness fields.
Failed health, missing compatibility, incompatible active artifacts, failed ecosystem replay, failed rollback preservation and unsigned or unbound metadata are visible as blockers.
Failure links point to promotion.blockers.show and do not clear or mutate blockers.
TUI projection exposes update_authority=false, rollback_authority=false, direct_update=false, direct_rollback=false and host_mutation_in_tui=false.
tui-replay and production-runbook-smoke include update.rollback.show and assert the update rollback panel remains read-only.
Full release build passed with promotion.status=promotable, blockers=[], and QEMU observed AGENTOS_TUI_CONSOLE_READY.
risk_notes: Update rollback panel reads local release artifacts only and never stages, commits or rolls back rootfs slots.
A/B rootfs execution authority remains AgentCore rootfs_update plus SecurityExecutionEngine.
The TUI cannot mutate update metadata, release provenance, slot state, rollback state or promotion blocker state.
